text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hishi Ama! You came too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Ah, Sweep's interview was on TV
the other day, you see.
It just reminded me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
About when you and I sent that girl
off to her debut race together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... There was a time like that, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What a strange twist of fate, though. To think I'd be watching Sweep's Takarazuka Kinen right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Come to think of it, both of us were supported by the fans, took on the Grand Prix, and failed to take 1st place, didn't we?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly.
If history's about to be made,
I wanna make damn sure I see it with my own two eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... What a coincidence, so am I.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now... show me, my sweet Sweepy.
I have been waiting for this day for so, so long.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, my bad.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Even blinking feels like a waste—
It'd be such a shame to let my vision blur with tears.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"—The Takarazuka Kinen. In the end, Rob Roy took 1st place in the fan voting.
I didn't even make the top 20."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Disappointed? Shocked? Not at all.
I just thought, "Same as always, huh."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I just thought, as usual, you're soooo booooring!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"There're probably still a ton more here anyway.
If it's just mile distances, that's one thing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In a middle-distance race, especially in the Senior class,
there's no way a girl from the Triple Tiara route
could ever beat girls from the Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You really are... an idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're here, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have arrived.
As promised... to become a hero.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha, indeed.
—All the more worthwhile to take down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's going to win, Rob Roy.
After all, this boring world is just filled with far too many fools.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, you're watching from over there, right!?
If you blink, I'll slap you later!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You'd better watch closely. Absolutely, positively.
Because I—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna change the world with magic right now!!
